units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 96:13">Sifré Deut. 96</cite>; <cite ref="Makkot 20a:12">Macc. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>לחייב על כל ק׳ וק׳</he> to be punishable for each act of making a bald spot; Sifra Emor, Par. 1, ch. I <cite ref="S02047"><he>קְרִיחָה</he></cite>.
Macc. 20ᵇ וכמה שיעור ק׳ what is the legal size of baldness (to be punishable)?; a. fr.—Trnsf. gap, depopulation.
<cite ref="Megillah 13b:18">Meg. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>שמא תאמר ק׳ אני וכ׳</he> lest thou say that I may create depopulation in thy empire (by the extermination of the Jews); a. e.—Pl. <he>קָרְחוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 36a:5">Kidd. 36ᵃ</cite> (<cite ref="Makkot 20a:12">Macc. 20ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>קריחות</he>), v. <cite ref="S01968"><he>קָרַח</he></cite>.
Y. Maasr. I, 48ᵈ bot., v. קָרַח Hif.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:1:13">Y. Meg. IV, 75ᵃ</cite> top (to those who read from the Law without benedictions) <he>עד מתי אתם … ק׳ ק׳</he> how long will you make the law into bare patches (sterile of spiritual seeds)?
